description.narrative: This project improves the delivery of services by the Anti-Corruption Agencies (ACAs) in Africa and the Caribbean. Improvements to ACAs will lead to reduced corruption, and in turn improving the effectiveness, efficiency, and equability public governance. Capacity building will be provided both through training, research and networking. Capacity building will take place through in country and regional training centres in Africa and the Caribbean. The project?s outputs will be delivered through the Commonwealth Africa Anti- Corruption Centre (CAACC) in Botswana established in partnership between the Secretariat and the Government of Botswana and the Centre of Excellence established between the Secretariat and the Government of Grenada. The Secretariat has established two associations of ACAs in Africa and the Caribbean. These networks will continue to build the capacity of the community of practice for corruption control. In addition, research and publication of anti-corruption related issues will be produced to share best practices of member countries doing well in the fight against corruption.
